title: Water-Chamber Parts Price Card — PAP Therapy Equipment Returns
content:
# Water-Chamber Parts Price Card — PAP Therapy Equipment Returns

**Card.** The water-chamber part a returned self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit takes in reconditioning, booked on its return inspection at Summit Ridge list price, depends on the humidifier:

| Humidifier furnished with the device | Patient's active PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment shows the humidifier in use | Chamber part | List price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | new water chamber | 24.00 |
| yes | no, or no active enrollment | chamber seal | 9.50 |
| no | any | no chamber part | 0.00 |

**In words.** A device furnished with a humidifier to a patient whose active PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment shows the humidifier in use takes a new water chamber at 24.00 USD; a device furnished with a humidifier whose use the supply enrollment does not show takes a chamber seal at 9.50 USD; a device without a humidifier takes no chamber part. The chamber part is added to the unit's reconditioning parts list.

**Where the facts are read.** "Furnished with a humidifier" is the humidifier-included indicator on the PAP Therapy Equipment device record. "In use" is the humidifier-in-use indicator on the patient's PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment that is in status active.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- A Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) furnished with a humidifier; the patient's active supply enrollment shows the humidifier in use: new water chamber, 24.00.
- The same device, but the active enrollment shows the humidifier not in use: chamber seal, 9.50.
- A CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) bought without a humidifier: no chamber part.
